title: Harvard University Financial Report, Fiscal Year 2002 (Financial Overview / Analysis of Financial Results)
publisher: Harvard University (Office of the Vice President for Finance)

notes: Only Harvard University Financial Report of any fiscal year found archived that covers FY2000 and FY2001 (no standalone FY2000 or FY2001 report was ever captured by the Wayback Machine under vpf-web.harvard.edu/annualfinancial/ -- confirmed via CDX search). Its Summary of Financial Results table is explicitly column-headed '1998 1999 2000 2001 2002' with row 'Total return on general investments 20.5% 12.2% 32.2% (2.7%) ( 0.5%)' and row 'Endowment funds, net assets 13,278.9 14,755.6 19,148.3 18,259.2 17,518.0' (dollars in millions). Source for FY2000, FY2001 and FY2002 return and market value. title: Harvard University Financial Report, Fiscal Year 2010
publisher: Harvard University (Office of the Vice President for Finance)
page: Message from the President (p. 2 of PDF) and Summary of Financial Results table (p. 4-5 of PDF)
notes: Return 11.0% and endowment value $27,557.4M both from this report (President's message and Summary of Financial Results; audited statements corroborate to the dollar, Note 10). BASIS NOTE: this value is the University's audited net-assets figure. Harvard's FY2007+ market values in this dataset are HMC's published endowment values, which run ~0.4-0.8% below the University line for the same years (the press-reported $27.4B for FY2010 is the HMC-basis equivalent, NOT a broader pool). Stored on the University basis because no HMC document exists for FY2010 (verified by CDX enumeration); the basis difference is disclosed in data/README.md's Harvard section per the never-splice-silently rule. QC-verified 2026-07-30: figures confirmed, original rationale corrected.
